entities.summary: Liu Yanhan is a Chinese volleyball player. She is an outside spiker and an opposite spiker. She won the 2015 and 2019 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Cup, and she was the Best Outside Spiker in 2019 FIVB Volleyball Women's Nations League.
